name: Marksans Pharma Limited
summary: Marksans Pharma Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, manufacturing, marketing, and sale of pharmaceutical formulations in the United States, North America, Europe, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, and internationally. The company offers products in the pain management, cardiovascular, central nervous system, anti-diabetic, gastrointestinal, analgesics, upper respiratory, ear care, skincare, anticancer, anti-ulcerative, anti-allergy, antiviral, dietary, cardiac, dermatology, antihistamines, anti-fungal, anti-viral, laxatives, and cold and cough therapeutic areas.
